bullets: The standard matrix inversion algorithm has a time complexity of O(n^3), which means that the computation time increases rapidly with the size of the matrix (increasing cubically with the number of components).
For Example: if Features vector is of size 1000 then Inverse calculation is or order 1,000,000,000 which is impractical
Instead of using Least Squares with Matrix inversion,
labels: if Feature vectors are of dimension d
(X^T X) is of size d+1 x d+1
